The sun rises high.
The birds begin to sing.
Dew drops fall down.
The wind blows soft.
A cat sleeps warm.
The dog runs fast.
Clouds drift across.
Rain starts to fall.

Lightning flashes bright.
The storm passes quick.
Rainbows appear now.

Peace stays within.
